paper.title: Agent0: Unleashing Self-Evolving Agents from Zero Data via Tool-Integrated Reasoning
paper.central_claim: 无人工训练数据的课程/执行器共演化，通过工具、多轮RL和ADPO提高数学及通用推理。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: We then train the Executor Agent

When the policy emits a tool-call trigger (i.e.,
‘‘‘python...‘‘‘
tags), generation is paused.
evidence.support_explanation: 临时代码调用，非留存工具库

evidence.quote: we propose Ambiguity-Dynamic Policy Optimization (ADPO), which incorporates two key modifications motivated by the data’s ambiguity signal
evidence.support_explanation: 更新算法改造而非prompt留存

evidence.quote: On Qwen3-8B-Base, the average math score improved from 55.1 (Iter 1) to 56.5 (Iter 2), peaking at 58.2 (Iter 3).
evidence.support_explanation: 三轮数值为训练后policy收益

evidence.quote: we use the previously determined majority answer
So we retain only those tasks whose self-consistency scores fall within an informative band:
evidence.support_explanation: 任务保留用于RL，不是部署非权重harness
另有judge依赖；zero-data不能等同无外部模型

evidence.quote: establishes a symbiotic competition between two agents initialized from the same base LLM: a curriculum agent that proposes increasingly challenging frontier tasks, and an executor agent that learns to solve them
evidence.support_explanation: Two agents from one base LLM; the learning of both is by training.
The curriculum agent's policy weights are updated with GRPO.

evidence.quote: The Executor Agent is updated by minimizing the ADPO objective
evidence.support_explanation: The executor's policy weights are updated with the ADPO objective.

evidence.quote: Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base models for both the Curriculum and Executor agents
evidence.support_explanation: Both retained improvements live in model weights; the code interpreter tool is fixed and not modified; generated tasks are transient training data.

evidence.quote: the curriculum agent is trained using RL to propose frontier tasks
evidence.support_explanation: The task generator's product is updated weights.

evidence.quote: the executor agent is trained via RL to successfully solve these tasks
evidence.support_explanation: The evaluated executor is a trained checkpoint.

evidence.quote: we integrate a sandboxed code interpreter
evidence.support_explanation: The tool is a fixed integration, not an evolved harness component.

claims.text: 零人工训练数据的工具共演化提高推理
claims.setting: Qwen3-4B/8B；3轮RL；7数学+3通用基准，AMC/AIME mean@32，其余greedy pass@1
claims.selection_vs_test: 合成题训练→benchmark测训练模型；无独立非权重状态复用对照
claims.result_denominator: 8B数学49.2→58.2；通用SuperGPQA28.3→33.0/MMLU-Pro51.8→63.4/BBEH8.6→13.7；表3General均值和表2口径不一致，不能混用
counterevidence: 无部署非权重留存收益
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告训练模型任务能力提升；不是harness RSI证据
